captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a solid, semi-cylindrical wedge shape with a curved outer profile. One end features a large flat circular face, while the body tapers along its length to form a thin, rounded edge on the opposite side. The surface is composed of many fine, parallel vertical slices, creating a ribbed texture along the curved profile.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric 3D model of a tapered cylindrical wedge. The script should approximate the curved taper by stacking a series of thin rectangular slices along an axis, with the slice dimensions determined by a mathematical curve to simulate a squished sphere or distorted cylinder. Allow users to adjust the overall diameter and the number of slices (sections) for resolution control.
captions.factory: The model is constructed using a loop that iterates from negative to positive half of the 'sections' variable. Inside the loop, it calculates the position and dimensions of each slice using a square root function based on the 'dia' parameter. Each slice is generated as a thin 'cube' primitive, translated along the X and Y axes, and then combined into a single solid using a 'union' operation.
